title: test(objectql): load the package entry with hook-run-as.test.ts, not inside its case
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XMJzDxfCB4ZBgkGR2dr7BYV)_

Fixes #26049

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What timed out, read from the logs

Both merge-queue ejections (build 40300684735 for #26012, Test Core 8/8; build 40302541664 for #26007, Test Core 8/8) fail at `src/hook-run-as.test.ts:389:5`, the case **"the seed is no nameable member of the published face: keyed on a symbol the package entry does not export"**. The triage comments truncate the FAIL line after the describe title, which made it read as the block's first case; the full title and the line number are in the job logs' `::error` annotation.

That case did `const entry = await import('./index.js')` inside the test body. The package entry pulls the rest of `@objectstack/objectql`'s module graph, which nothing else in this file loads, so the case paid a cold transform and import of the package inside its 5000 ms budget. The resolver path the card suspected is not the cost: `resolveUserAuthzGrants` is a static import in `engine.ts`, and the block's first case runs in 1 ms.

## The fix (test-only)

`import * as entry from './index.js'` at the top of the file, the same idiom the package's `*-code-constant.test.ts` files use for the barrel. The load now happens at file collection, outside any per-case window. The case becomes synchronous and keeps all five assertions unchanged (`SEED_USER_GRANTS` and `APP_AUTHORED_HOOK_API` absent from the entry, `withUserGrantsSeeded` absent from the prototype, two symbol-keyed members). No quarantine, skip, retry or timeout change. No product code touched.

## Evidence

Run: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 --reporter=verbose src/hook-run-as.test.ts`, under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, with 8 `node -e 'for(;;){}'` busy loops alongside on a 4-core container (2x oversubscribed, standing in for the ui lanes running beside Test Core). Shared-box seconds.

| | case time | file result | `tests` phase |
|---|---|---|---|
| quiet box, `origin/main` 9753d163 | 2513 ms | 29/29 | 2.61 s |
| under load, `origin/main`, 5 runs | 5016, 5021, 5366, 5413, 5070 ms (all `Test timed out in 5000ms.`) | 5 of 5 red, 1 failed / 28 passed | 5.27–5.73 s |
| under load, this branch, 5 runs | 1, 0, 0, 0, 1 ms | 5 of 5 green, 29/29 | 0.20–0.37 s |

The load did not disappear; it moved. Under load the file's `import` phase went from 12.8–17.9 s (before) to 20.3–26.3 s (after), and whole-file wall time stayed in the same 18–27 s band. That phase is not bounded by `testTimeout`.

Local verification at the final head: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck` exit 0 (`check:test-typecheck` OK, test-layer debt held); `eslint packages/objectql --no-inline-config` exit 0; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test` exit 0 (470 files / 8748 tests passed); the derived gate list (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`) 58 derived, 57 run with exit 0, 1 NOT MEASURED (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, exit 3: needs a full build); `--ran` reconciles 58/58 at `d8e4f756c`.

## Changeset

`skip-changeset`: the diff is one `*.test.ts` file, and `@objectstack/objectql`'s `files[]` is `dist`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, so nothing published changes.

## Acceptance notes

- `packages/objectql/src/bound-action-collision-report.test.ts:111` has the same shape (`await import('./index.js')` inside a "no nameable member of the published face" case). It has not ejected a queue build, and it is outside this claim's file surface, so it is untouched here; reported to the seat.
